title: Chapter 696 - 696 Return; Missing!
content:
Chapter 696 - 696 Return; Missing!

Chapter 696 - 696 Return; Missing!

696 Return; Missing!

An epiphany!

This was a word that only existed in legends.

More and more people cast curious gazes over.

Some people’s eyes flickered as if they were thinking about something. However, after seeing the people around the Enlightenment Tablet, they gradually calmed down.

Some people were envious, while others wanted to befriend Lin Fan…

However, no one spent too much time on Lin Fan.

This was because this was the only chance in their life to reach the Enlightenment Tablet. They could not miss it.

Time flew by like water.

Four years passed in a flash.

Lin Fan had finally escaped from the state of Heaven and Earth Enlightenment.

The white energy around him slowly dissipated.

At the same time, Lin Fan’s body emitted a vast aura. It was as if he was looking down as the only ruler of the world, making people feel like worshipping him.

At this moment, a series of notifications rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! It’s been seven years since you’ve obtained the advanced system. Reward: 100,000,000 experience points, Epiphany of Heaven and Earth x1, Elementary Rule Upgrade Gem x1.]

[Ding! It’s been eight years since you’ve obtained the advanced system. Reward: 200,000,000 experience points, Path-Understanding Tree x1.]

[Ding! It’s been nine years since you’ve obtained the advanced system. Reward: 300 million experience points, Immortal Rice Seeds x10.]

[Ding! It’s been ten years since you’ve obtained the advanced system. Reward: 400 million experience points, Movie Viewing Skill.]

The advanced system was obviously very intelligent.

It knew that Lin Fan was in a state of enlightenment and could not be disturbed. Therefore, it did not give out any rewards.

Then, a series of notifications rang out in his mind.

[Ding! Your cultivation level increased to level-four Planet (980 million/100 million)]

[Ding! Your cultivation level increased to level-five Planet (880 million/200 million)]

[Ding! Your cultivation level increased to level-six Planet (680 million/500 million)]

[Ding! Your cultivation level increased to level-seven Planet (180 million/1 billion)]

Instantly, Lin Fan’s entire body seemed to have turned into a sun that hung high up in the sky, emitting an endless amount of dazzling light. It was majestic and vast!

The violent storm spread out with Lin Fan at the center, causing the clothes of everyone around the Enlightenment Tablet to rustle. In fact, they could not help but take a few steps back.

Lin Fan let out a breath of air and retracted his aura. Only then did the scene return to normal.

However, everyone still looked at Lin Fan in fear, unable to speak for a long time.

At this moment, a stream of light appeared around everyone.

The stream of light revolved around them continuously. The space flowed at a high speed and produced a powerful suction force, pulling everyone in.

With Lin Fan’s current control over space, he could completely break free from the pull of space.

However, he did not do so.

That was because he had sensed it and knew that the other side of this spatial passageway was Revelation Planet.

Lin Fan understood that it was time for the Heavenly Wind World to close.

In the next moment…

Lin Fan, Ma Zheng, and everyone else who had entered the Heavenly Wind World returned to the square where they had entered.

After returning to the square, everyone could not help but look around. They quietly pulled away from the people around them.

This was because they had more or less obtained some opportunities in the Heavenly Wind World.

Wealth moved people’s hearts, no matter where it was.

“Master!”

“Master!”

“Ancestor!”

Some people quickly noticed the people in the distance who were emitting powerful auras and shouted excitedly.

Then, they rushed over.

Among them, an old man with a youthful face and white hair used his sharp eyes to scan the crowd.

“None of the five of them are here? How is this possible?”

This old man was called Chu Xiong, the famous Star Lord of Gray Planet.

Soon, his eyes locked onto Ma Zheng.

Strictly speaking, it was locked onto the spear in Ma Zheng’s hand.

Chu Xiong took a step forward and shot toward Ma Zheng like a sharp arrow.

He stretched out his hand and formed a claw, sweeping with a tyrannical force as he slapped at Ma Zheng.

The space shattered and the wind howled.

This claw was enough to tear Ma Zheng into pieces.

At this moment, Lin Fan raised his hand and pointed out. A sharp finger sword shot out, piercing through Chu Xiong’s claws and his entire body, crushing him into nothingness.

Silence!

The entire scene was deathly silent!

Lin Fan had attacked without holding back.

That was because he noticed that Chu Xiong had attacked in anger after seeing Ma Zheng’s spear.

The spear came from the hands of the Five Masters of the Gray Planet.

Lin Fan knew who this person was with just a thought. He must be the Star Lord of Gray Planet.

He had killed five of his disciples, so he would not rest until one of them died.

Since that was the case, the right choice was to strike first.

Very quickly, the people present verified Lin Fan’s guess.

“That was… the Star Lord of Gray Planet, Chu Xiong?”

“Why did he suddenly disappear?”

“What exactly happened?”

…

Ma Zheng, who was standing beside Lin Fan, could not help but swallow his saliva.

Others were far away and might not have been able to see clearly.

However, Ma Zheng, who was right in front, saw everything very clearly.

One finger!

Lin Fan had killed Chu Xiong with a single finger!

That was Chu Xiong!

Ten thousand years ago, he was already a Planet level super warrior!

In the end, he was killed by Lin Fan with a single finger!

Just how strong was Lin Fan?

Ma Zheng looked at Lin Fan with respect.

“T-Thank you, Senior Lin.”

[Ding! Ma Zheng’s favorability toward you has increased to seven stars.]

“It’s just a small matter,” Lin Fan said.

He looked around and said, “Let’s go.”

“Yes,” Ma Zheng said respectfully.

Lin Fan did not stay on Revelation Planet for too long. He took an interstellar flying device and went around the many planets in the Spring Region before jumping into the universe and teleporting away.

Compared to when he first came out from Earth, the speed and distance of Lin Fan’s teleportation was clearly much faster.

Half a month later, a blue planet appeared in his vision. It was Earth.

Lin Fan’s figure flashed and he arrived at the Coiling Dragon Villa.

“Lil Fan!”

“Brother!”

“Lin Fan!”

“Honey!”

In the Coiling Dragon Villa, shouts immediately rang out one after another.

Then, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Hu Tian, Qiu Ziqian, Su Ningjing, and a large group of people ran out quickly.

Even though it had been ten years since Lin Fan left Earth, none of their faces had changed.

On the contrary, their skin became fairer, and their faces became smoother and more beautiful.

This was because the Earth now had a huge amount of spiritual energy. Their lifespan and health had all been greatly improved.

Other than that, Lin Fan had also left behind a large amount of beauty potions, spirit stones, and spirit fruits…Forget about a mere ten years, even if it was tens or hundreds of years, Hu Tian, Qiu Ziqian, Su Ningjing, and the others would definitely not age.

“I missed you so much.” Qiu Ziqian, Su Ningjing, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, and the others all spoke at once.

Their voices were filled with tenderness.

Lin Fan’s heart melted instantly. “I missed you guys too.”
